properties.name: Spirit Discernment
properties.description: Perceives the nature of a spirit or curse and works out the Form, the Truth and the Reason behind it.

properties.name: Threefold Knowing
properties.description: The sealed sword can be drawn only once the Form, the Truth and the Reason of the spirit are all known.

properties.name: Exorcist Blade
properties.description: A sealed sword that dispels a spirit once it is drawn.

properties.name: Warding Talismans
properties.description: Paper seals that bind, repel and hold a spirit in place.

properties.name: Wandering Peddler
properties.description: Travels as a seller of remedies, an outsider who is neither trusted nor welcome, which gives a reason to ask questions.

properties.name: Inscrutable Manner
properties.description: Calm, courteous and cryptic; reveals little and leads others to speak their own truth.

visual_traits.descriptor: tall, slender frame with a straight, unhurried carriage
pale, angular face with red lines drawn around the eyes and a calm, courteous expression
long dark hair tied back at the nape
a boldly patterned pale kimono worn under a dark outer robe
ivory, pale blue and red accents
a tall wooden cabinet of many small drawers strapped to the back
a sealed sword slowly sliding from its sheath as three glowing characters appear in the air

exclusion_candidates.reason: An object's lore, not a transferable mechanic.

exclusion_candidates.item: the recurring spirit antagonists and their stories
the remedy cabinet as a carried object
exclusion_candidates.reason: A prop; at most its look can be echoed.
